title: metadata-protocol: getMetaItemsForExecution files one pair package's bound flow override under another package's slot, by registration order (ADR-0150 D4, red line 2)
body:
epic:#31527#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYGYEUhpi29FpjLmxT

Parent: #31527 (ADR-0150, epic red line 2: ambiguity reported, never guessed). Found by server seat 5 while working #32552 (finding F1). Measured on `238b9ee69` with #32568's locations 1–4 applied locally. #32568's hydrator fix does not cover it. Probe: `/mnt/project-files/server-seatC/card-32552/probe-32552.test.ts` (PROBE2).

## Premise

Two namespaces, alpha and beta, each ship flow `F`, and each has a declared `.custom` override row bound to its own package (OVR-A and OVR-B). `getMetaItemsForExecution({ type: 'flow' })` answers by registration order:

- alpha registered first: `alpha:OVR-A` twice, `alpha:OVR-B`, `beta:OVR-B`
- beta registered first: `alpha:OVR-A`, `beta:OVR-A`, `beta:OVR-B` twice

So one package's override is executed under the other package's name. The answer also changes with registration order.

Likely root (the finder's reading): the pair's already-bound rows enter the same bare slot through `incomingTakesStoredFlowSlot` in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-registry-hydration.ts` (around `:526`). #32568's fix deliberately does not touch flows or bound pair rows.

After #32552's fix, action shows the same wrong entry (`alpha:OVERRIDE-beta` when alpha registers first). So #32552 waits for this card (epic ruling, 2026-11-12 08:00Z).

## Fix shape

- Each bound override row goes into its own package's slot, and is never taken by the bare slot when two packages hold the name.
- Sweep every reader of `incomingTakesStoredFlowSlot`, plus the other execution-face readers, for the same shortcut. Cover flow and action.
- Pin both registration orders. Expected answer: exactly `alpha:OVR-A` and `beta:OVR-B`. Add a one-holder CONTROL.
- Declare the move FROM → TO with its arm. Expected first-party count: 0.

## Order

- Server seat 5's lane.
- Start from PR #32507's branch (`claude/project-thread-wqgmuu`). PR #32507 re-keys flows per package and lands first in the chain.
- Lands after #32568 and before #32552.

Blocked-by: #32568
